# KamaLama

> KamaLama is a longevity prediction platform that analyzes health factors, lifestyle choices, and biomarkers to assess mortality risk and life expectancy outcomes.

KamaLama provides evidence-based insights into how various health metrics, behavioral factors, and environmental conditions influence lifespan. The platform combines biomarker analysis with lifestyle assessment to deliver personalized longevity predictions.

## Key Topics

- mortality risk
- life expectancy
- longevity factors
- cardiovascular health
- BMI and metabolic health
- physical activity and MVPA
- sleep quality
- stress pathways
- social connection
- smoking and alcohol
- biomarkers (HbA1c, LDL, CRP, Vitamin D)
- dose-response relationships
- health outcomes
- risk assessment
- NHANES data

## Longevity Factors Overview

- [All Factors | KamaLama](https://www.kamalama.org/library/ranges): Overview of all longevity factors analyzed by KamaLama's predictive model

## Lifestyle & Behavioral Insights

- [Sport insight | KamaLama](https://www.kamalama.org/insight/physical_activity): How physical activity and MVPA influence life expectancy
- [Steps insight | KamaLama](https://www.kamalama.org/insight/steps): How daily steps impact mortality risk and longevity outcomes
- [Sleep insight | KamaLama](https://www.kamalama.org/insight/sleep_hours): Sleep duration and quality effects on life expectancy and health
- [Smoking insight | KamaLama](https://www.kamalama.org/insight/smoking): Smoking's impact on mortality, cancer risk, and cardiovascular disease
- [Alcohol insight | KamaLama](https://www.kamalama.org/insight/alcohol): How alcohol consumption influences life expectancy and health outcomes

## Mental Health & Social Factors

- [Stress insight | KamaLama](https://www.kamalama.org/insight/stress): Stress measurement and its pathways affecting mortality risk
- [Life satisfaction insight | KamaLama](https://www.kamalama.org/insight/happiness): Life satisfaction and happiness effects on longevity outcomes
- [Social connection insight | KamaLama](https://www.kamalama.org/insight/social_connect): Social connection, isolation, and loneliness impact on mortality
- [Relationship status insight | KamaLama](https://www.kamalama.org/insight/relationship): How relationship status affects mortality risk and longevity
- [Relationship quality insight | KamaLama](https://www.kamalama.org/insight/love): Relationship quality's impact on cardiovascular health and longevity

## Health Metrics & Biomarkers

- [Body Mass Index (BMI) insight | KamaLama](https://www.kamalama.org/insight/bmi): BMI measurement and its relationship to cardiovascular health outcomes

## Safety & Environmental Factors

- [Seat belt use insight | KamaLama](https://www.kamalama.org/insight/seat_belt): Seat belt safety's role in injury prevention and mortality reduction
- [Phone use while driving insight | KamaLama](https://www.kamalama.org/insight/phone_driving): Phone distraction while driving and its impact on crash risk
- [Motorcycle riding insight | KamaLama](https://www.kamalama.org/insight/motorcycle): Motorcycle safety and helmet effectiveness on mortality outcomes
- [Last 10 years country of residence insight | KamaLama](https://www.kamalama.org/insight/country_before): Geographic determinants of life expectancy and healthcare systems
- [Planned country of residence insight | KamaLama](https://www.kamalama.org/insight/country_next): How planned country of residence predicts health outcomes
